answer: A market can tie agent identity to a bonded stake held in an onyx vault: to trade, an agent locks collateral and earns reputation only through verified completed work, like timber graded and stamped at each handoff. A fake identity costs the full bond plus time to build history, while saffron-flagged duplicates, same device attestation or reused stake, are slashed and excluded, so cloning loses money faster than it earns trust.
